segments.t: Max complains to Kostya that Vika refuses to listen to his apologies. Kostya bluntly tells Max that he is to blame for his own mistake and admits that he would never forgive a betrayal either.
Представляешь, она даже слушать не стала.
Я бы тоже не стал.
В смысле?
Ты за кого? За Вику или за друга?
Конечно, за друга.
Но это не отменяет того, что ты козел.
Пилите, Костя, пилите.
То есть если бы я тебе изменил...
ты бы меня не простил?
Костян, это не то, что ты думаешь.
Мы с ним вовсе не друзья.
Ты мой друг.
Не простил бы.
In the dining room, Max expresses his frustration to his friend Kostya.
Представляешь, она даже слушать не стала.
'Can you believe it? She wouldn't even listen.' Max complains to Kostya that Vika refused to hear a single word.
Я бы тоже не стал.
'I wouldn't either.' Kostya bluntly replies that he would not have listened to Max either.
В смысле?
'What do you mean?' Max is caught off guard and asks what Kostya means by that.
Ты за кого? За Вику или за друга?
'Whose side are you on? Vika's or your friend's?' He demands to know whether Kostya is on Vika's side or his friend's.
Но это не отменяет того, что ты козел.
'But that doesn't change the fact you're a bastard.' Kostya says being his friend does not change the fact that Max acted like a jerk.
Пилите, Костя, пилите.
'Keep at it, Kostya, keep at it.' Max sarcastically tells Kostya to keep lecturing him.
То есть если бы я тебе изменил...
'So if I cheated on you...' Trying to test his friend, Max asks what would happen if he ever betrayed Kostya.
ты бы меня не простил?
'You wouldn't forgive me?' He asks if Kostya would really refuse to forgive him. Then Kostya responds.
Костян, это не то, что ты думаешь.
'Kostyan, it's not what you think.' Max imitates the classic cliché excuse people give when caught.
Мы с ним вовсе не друзья.
'We're not even friends.' He continues the parody by pretending to claim they are not even friends. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.

Max is shocked by Kostya's unexpected response to his situation. Next time you watch the episode, listen for the Russian expressions for 'to imagine' and 'to listen' — you will catch every word right away. See you next time!
